_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-09. CardID = 17600 + idx; 344 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 44). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, which is why the catalog says card_count 31 and card_ids [344, 17629]. Ciri's deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the four turtles', Doctor Strange's, Bigfoot's, Daredevil's, Luke Cage's, Bullseye's and Tomoe Gozen's: only deck.identity (data/tts/ciri.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Hero card (read from the image): CIRI, MELEE, START HEALTH 15, MOVE 2; special ability 'UNCONTAINABLE POWER: (Source 7) Effects on Ciri's cards cannot be canceled.'; sidekick IHUARRAQUAX, MELEE, START HEALTH 7 (move 2 from unmatched-memory). One of each.

SOURCE: the Source dial of the bag (MAX_VALUE 13 = the 13 cards that carry the Source orb) counts the Source cards in Ciri's discard pile, exactly like Hellboy's destinies: the `source` counter below. A card with a numbered orb applies the highest threshold the count reaches (docs/heroes/ciri.md, Open questions). Cards with the orb in the art band (tag `source`): Lion cub of Cintra x3, Pushed to the brink x3, Zireael x3, The lady of space and time x2, Child of the Elder Blood x2 = 13. Channel the source, Blink, Bane of the Aen Elle and Searching strike carry no orb (Ciri's Channel the source and Searching strike text mention the orb cards).

Printed text differences from unmatched-memory: the numbered orbs are written SOURCE n: here (memory: the orb emoji and 'x n'); Unicorn ally's ONGOING lines are missing from unmatched-memory (it only has 'Ciri recovers 2 health.'). The Ciri band is on 19 cards, IHUARRAQUAX on 6 (Bane of the Aen Elle, Searching strike), ANY on 5 (Parry, Unicorn ally).
Copies (xN printed on each card), type, value and boost match unmatched-memory for all 11 titles.
